title: Slash world (world.json)
description: One continuous vertical world. Vertical scroll is the primary axis, measured in viewport-heights; the camera descends through a world that is fixed in space, so environments stream past while camera-following actors stay framed. Objects are placed at an absolute worldY within a parallax layer. There are no scenes or cuts — atmosphere, framing and parallax are continuous over global progress g in [0,1]. A second, independent input: horizontal swipes turn the view around the content (see `rotation`) without changing vertical position.

length.description: Total scroll length in viewport-heights. Sets the scroll spacer height and the denominator of global progress g.

travelPerUnit.description: Metres the camera descends per viewport-height of scroll. The knob that ties scroll feel to world scale. Default 1.

rotation.description: Horizontal-swipe rotation. A swipe left/right orbits the camera around the vertical axis through its look-at point, at unchanged height — the content turns on a circular path while vertical position stays under scroll control alone. Rotation is free (any angle, both directions) and persists while scrolling.

degreesPerWidth.description: Degrees the world turns per full-viewport-width drag. The knob that ties swipe feel to world scale, as travelPerUnit does for scroll. Default 180.

camera.description: A dolly rig that descends with scroll. offset/target are authored relative to the descending travel point; optional drift adds subtle motion over g. Horizontal swipes orbit this camera around its look-at point (see `rotation`).

offset.description: Camera position relative to the travel point, in metres.

target.description: Look-at point relative to the travel point, in metres.

drift.description: Restrained art-directed motion: offsets added over global progress g in [0,1]. Keep it subtle.

layers.description: Parallax plates, back-to-front. Every object names a layer. parallax 1 = true world space (full parallax); parallax → 0 = rides the camera (appears infinitely far).

parallax.description: Extra parallax factor on top of natural perspective.

objects.description: Stages and props placed along the vertical axis. Position = transform (X/Z lateral offset) with worldY added to Y.

worldY.description: Vertical placement in metres (added to transform.position Y).

actors.description: Characters that persist through the scroll. follow "camera" rides the descending rig (stays framed while the world streams past); follow "world" is placed at worldY and left behind as the camera passes.

follow.description: camera = travels with the viewer through the world (stays framed); world = anchored at worldY. Default world.

worldY.description: Vertical placement for follow "world" actors (ignored when follow is "camera").

idleClip.description: Name of a glTF animation clip to loop while idle.

tracks.description: Transform animation keyed over global progress g in [0,1]. For camera-following actors this is motion relative to the rig (sway, bob).

environment.description: Continuous atmosphere over the whole descent, keyframed over global progress g.

fog.description: Linear fog whose colour and range animate over g. Colour is RGB in [0,1] (array form so it can be keyframed).

lights.description: World lighting. When present, replaces the runtime default lights. Tracks animate over g (time-of-day shifts).

follow.description: camera = the light rides the descending rig (a key light that follows the traveler); world = fixed in space. Default camera.

effects.description: Ambient particle effects that travel with the viewer, animated over g.

area.description: Emission box size in metres. Default [20,10,20].

position.description: Centre of the emission box (relative to the viewer).

transform.description: Position in metres, rotation as XYZ euler degrees, uniform or per-axis scale.

easing.description: Interpolation from the previous keyframe to this one. Default linear.

vec3Track.description: Keyframes over global progress g in [0,1], sorted by t.
